description: Strassen und Wege: Kantonsstrassen Riehen und Bettingen is a dataset listed in Datenportal Basel-Stadt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Amt für Mobilität. Dieser Datensatz ist Teil des kantonalen Geodatenmodells des Kantons Basel-Stadt "Strassen und Wege" und stellt die Kantonsstrassen Riehen und Bettingen dar. Weitere Daten zu "Strassen und Wege": Die Kantonsstrassen Riehen und Bettingen zeigen die Kantonsstrassen in Riehen und Bettingen. Coverage: Canton of Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under Geography, Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Weg, Mobilität, Strassennetz, Strasse, Wegnetz. The portal shows 13 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-10-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bs-ch-portal.
